annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes participation in the Forsage system by claiming unusually high personal earnings, stating that viewers can also earn money, and directing them to call the displayed number. The dashboard shows a large team count, Forsage program matrices, and a personal link inviting viewers to sign up with the promoter's upline, indicating recruitment-linked earning claims rather than neutral commentary.

The video encourages viewers to join this recruitment-linked system through direct contact with the promoter.
